source_inspiration.notes: Used as demand research only: people want help making visual-generation prompts consistent and inspectable. No third-party prompt text was copied and no outside engagement is represented as PathForge activity.

pathforge_fit_adaptation: Adapted the image-prompt-generator demand into a deterministic offline studio that decomposes one visual brief into subject, style, camera, palette, and negative-prompt consistency tiles, flags drift, and exports a clean brief before any generation. It is not a hosted image generator, API wrapper, prompt marketplace clone, or remote AI/image service.

artifact_versions.notes: First real artifact from ChatGPT Medium. Preserved because verification found a concrete fixable layout defect: hidden chip checkbox inputs inherited full input width while absolutely positioned, causing desktop horizontal overflow.
Final verified artifact. Repair constrained hidden chip inputs to 1px/clipped controls and added min-width/overflow-wrap guards so desktop and forced 390px viewports do not scroll sideways.

verification_notes: Preflight before provider work passed: npm run check:source-run-intake and npm run check:hourly-seed-manager.

v1 artifact saved under public/artifacts and rendered, but Chrome verification found horizontal overflow on desktop: scrollWidth 2311 vs clientWidth 1405. Overflowing elements were hidden checkbox inputs inside chip labels inheriting full input width while absolutely positioned.
One repair prompt was sent in the same ChatGPT source session naming the hidden checkbox overflow defect.

Final static scans passed: no innerHTML, outerHTML, document.write, insertAdjacentHTML, eval, new Function, javascript: URLs, remote http/https references, Google Fonts, CDN references, @import, or inline event-handler attributes in the final artifact.

Final desktop Chrome verification via localhost passed: title rendered, drift warnings appeared for conflicting realism/illustration, warm/cool palette, and close/wide camera cues; Copy brief wrote a VISUAL BRIEF containing generation and negative prompt drafts to the browser clipboard; final desktop overflow false with scrollWidth 1405 and clientWidth 1405.

Final forced 390px headless Chrome DevTools measurement passed: innerWidth 390, clientWidth 375, scrollWidth 375, overflow false, no overflowing elements, title Visual Brief Tile Studio, copy button present.
final_artifact_clue: Open public/artifacts/micro-image-brief-consistency-tiles-chatgpt.html; fill the brief tiles, intentionally mix style/camera/palette cues to see drift warnings, then use Copy brief or Download .txt.

steps.prompt_exact: I need a little save-and-open browser studio for visual briefs that breaks one image idea into subject, style, camera, palette, and negative-prompt consistency tiles, flags drift between tiles, and gives me a clean brief to copy before I generate anything.
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned a complete offline HTML visual brief tile studio with localStorage, drift rules, copy and download controls.
